combinations.evidence_quote: Intranasal administration of i-BET762 (BET inhibitor) or SAHA (HDAC inhibitor) attenuated thermal and mechanical hypersensitivity and this antiallodynic activity was improved by co-administration of both drugs.

combinations.magnitude: stronger reduction than each agent alone
combinations.evidence_quote: produced a stronger reduction compared to each epigenetic agent alone.

combinations.readout: microglia activation markers (IBA1, CD11b, iNOS, NF-kB, STAT1)
combinations.evidence_quote: SAHA and i-BET762, administered alone or in combination, counteracted the SNI-induced microglia activation by inhibiting the expression of IBA1, CD11b, inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), the activation of nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) and signal transducer and activator of transcription-1 (STAT1) with comparable efficacy.

combinations.magnitude: modest single effects significantly potentiated by combination
combinations.evidence_quote: Conversely, the epigenetic inhibitors showed a modest effect on spinal proinflammatory cytokines content that was significantly potentiated by their combination.
